faq.question: What types of engineers can I hire through Offline Pixel?
faq.answer: Offline Pixel provides access to specialists across Rust systems, AI infrastructure, LLM applications, RAG systems, FastAPI backends, quantitative engineering, mobile applications, distributed systems, data platforms, and other advanced software engineering domains.

faq.question: How does the engagement process work?
faq.answer: Submit your requirements to Offline Pixel, discuss scope directly with an expert, agree on budget, NDA requirements, and timelines, fund the engagement, review completed deliverables, and release payment once the work is approved.

faq.question: How quickly can I get started?
faq.answer: Most project requests receive an initial technical review within 48 to 72 hours. Project kickoff timelines depend on scope, complexity, and expert availability.

faq.question: Can I speak directly with the expert before hiring?
faq.answer: Yes. Clients can discuss requirements, technical feasibility, timelines, architecture decisions, and budgets directly with experts before starting an engagement.

faq.question: What engagement models are available?
faq.answer: Offline Pixel supports fixed-price projects, milestone-based delivery, hourly consulting, retainers, fractional engineering support, and long-term contract engagements.

faq.question: Do you support NDA-protected projects?
faq.answer: Yes. If your project requires confidentiality, an NDA can be agreed upon before any sensitive information, source code, or business documentation is shared.

faq.question: Who owns the intellectual property?
faq.answer: Unless otherwise agreed in writing, ownership of approved deliverables transfers to the client after full payment has been completed.

faq.question: How are project payments handled?
faq.answer: Funds are held by Offline Pixel until agreed milestones or project completion are approved by the client.

faq.question: Can large projects be delivered in phases?
faq.answer: Yes. Larger initiatives are encouraged to use milestone-based delivery with clearly defined phases, deliverables, approvals, and payment releases.

faq.question: Is there a maximum project size?
faq.answer: Individual engagements are currently limited to $5,000 USD. Larger initiatives should be divided into multiple phases or milestones with separate approvals and funding.

faq.question: Do you work with international clients?
faq.answer: Yes. Offline Pixel supports organizations across North America, Europe, the United Kingdom, the Middle East, Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, and other global markets.

faq.question: Why use Offline Pixel instead of traditional freelance marketplaces?
faq.answer: Offline Pixel focuses on specialized engineering expertise, direct communication, transparent project scoping, secure payment workflows, and long-term technical partnerships rather than high-volume bidding.
